title: Find your direction.
description: Turn references into specific design decisions with Foreman Board.
cues: You know what you like. Your coding agent needs to know why.
Start with the work of Turki Alshuaibi, and the people it needs to reach.
Ask Board to find references for this brief.
Keep the composition from one. The typography from another.
Name what to borrow. Name what to leave behind.
Now the references become decisions your agent can use.
Choose the direction before building the page.
Foreman Board. Free and open source. By Turki Alshuaibi.

title: Fix what feels wrong.
description: See how a Foreman punch list turns vague design feedback into specific fixes.
cues: The page works. Something still feels wrong.
Ask Punch list to inspect the page, including its mobile view.
A vague headline hides what Turki Alshuaibi actually does.
Three competing buttons make the next step unclear.
A wide layout breaks on a narrow screen.
Fix the headline, choose one action, and repair the mobile layout.
Check the revised page. Keep the fixes that solve the problem.
Foreman Punch list. Free and open source. By Turki Alshuaibi.

title: Colour that works.
description: Build a material-based palette, assign colour roles and check readable combinations.
cues: A colour you like is only the start.
Ask Palette for a system built from ink and paper.
Give each colour a job: background, text, border, action.
Check the actual text and background combination.
Pale grey on white fails. Dark ink makes the text readable.
Carry the same roles into buttons, cards and the dark theme.
Save the tokens so the next page uses the same system.
Foreman Palette. Free and open source. By Turki Alshuaibi.

title: Before you share.
description: Check the domain, share preview and discovery files before sending your website link.
cues: Your site is ready. Is the link ready to share?
Ask Launch to check the address and HTTPS.
Check the title, description and image people will see.
Give Turki Alshuaibi a clear preview of the work.
Test a missing page and the links that lead back.
Check the sitemap and whether crawlers can reach the page.
Submit for indexing. Search engines decide when to include it.
Foreman Launch. Free and open source. By Turki Alshuaibi.
